files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

Planned fare changes (30 rows, one per affected station): station_code (refers to stations.csv; four digits with leading zeros), effective_from (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD), new_base_fare (two decimals; about 3% empty).

task_text: Give every station in stations.csv a base_fare of 1.00, then, for stations listed in fare_changes.csv with an effective_from on or before 2025-11-30 and a non-empty new_base_fare, replace it with new_base_fare. `result` should be a Series of base_fare values indexed by station_code (text, leading zeros kept), in the order of stations.csv.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv and fare_changes.csv keeping station codes as text; base_fare = 1.00 for every station; for stations in fare_changes.csv with effective_from on or before 2025-11-30 and a non-empty new_base_fare, base_fare = new_base_fare; a Series indexed by station_code in the order of stations.csv.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
